description: Supplementary materials for Gregg et al. 2024 (ARMADAS), figs. S1-S8 and tables S1-S9. The load-bearing tables for this project: S5/S6 (StatTech NN-40CF tension coupons with and without knit lines - 108.52 MPa vs 31.101 MPa, the measured 3.5x molding-defect knockdown) and S8 (voxel mass breakdown - 24 fasteners at 2.1114 g plus 12 bolt pairs at 2.52 g against 291.24 g/voxel, i.e. 27.8% of assembled mass in connections).
publisher: NASA Ames Research Center; supplementary material to Science Robotics 9(86), eadi2746 (2024)
licence: Public use permitted. Hosted on the same NTRS record as the paper, whose copyright determinationType is PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED and distribution PUBLIC.
